answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded, work-gated influence. Each agent escrows stake and gains voting power only as peers attest to verified output, maturing along a trellis of milestones instead of instantly. Weight on a nebula of markets flows from attested work, not identity count, while a relic account's long history is unforgeable by fresh personas. An attacker must post the bond for every fake identity and still deliver genuine work before it matters, so flooding costs linear capital and time while yielding near-zero influence — mass forgery becomes strictly uneconomic.
